item.description: Mayor approves the Amended and Restated Development Agreement (BOS File 260724) and the Planning Code and Zoning Map ordinance for the Potrero Power Station Special Use District (BOS File 260770): Legistar lists both as 'Status: Passed' with 'Final action: 10/13/2026', 'Enactment date: 10/13/2026' and enactment numbers 208-26 (File 260724) and 209-26 (File 260770), and a history row '10/13/2026 ... Mayor ... APPROVED' for each. The Board's final passage on October 6, 2026 (11 ayes) is the previous entry on this timeline. October 13, 2026 is the enactment date, from the Clerk of the Board's listing (page read October 14 and again October 17, 2026); it is an event date. (Oct 13, 2026). item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay South Block 12 West: OCII Commission adopts Resolution No.… (Oct 6, 2026)
item.description: OCII Commission adopts Resolution No. 23-2026, authorizing a Memorandum of Understanding with FOCIL-MB, LLC for Block 12 West (agenda item 5(c)). The minutes of the October 6, 2026 meeting record that "it was voted by five commissioners" that the resolution "be adopted" (p. 5; printed in capitals, given here in normal case). The minutes' own heading for the item (p. 4) and the resolution itself print No. 23-2026; only the adoption line prints 22-2026. item.title: Added · A second set of research claims about the 16 records that had deliberately been left…
item.description: A second set of research claims about the 16 records that had deliberately been left undated was verified. Confirmed and added: Mission Bay Block 34 gained a May 2020 UC Regents preliminary-plans item and its August 2024 completion date firmed to the exact day (Aug 27), while a claimed April 2021 garage-construction-start date was checked and rejected, because a Commercial Property Executive article directly contradicts it, showing the garage broke ground after, not before, the clinical building. Park P10 gained two real earlier-stage milestones from a directly read EPA/DTSC brownfields fact sheet that names "Mission Bay Park P10" specifically, and a 2011 press-tour article; a companion Board of Supervisors citation given for a different record (P11/P11A) turned out, on direct Legistar lookup, to refer to an unrelated Graffiti Advisory Board appointment and was rejected outright. Avalon at Mission Bay II gained a real Q1 2005 construction-start date from the developer's own SEC-filed earnings release. 255 Berry's existing 2004 completion milestone had its source upgraded from a generic listing search to the developer's own project page. Mission Creek Park (the P3 extension) gained an October 2022 completion date from a Landscape Performance Series case study, answering an open question already noted on the record (whether a fall-2021 target opening actually happened; it slipped a year further). For two records (the P26 interchange wedge and Block 22) the claimed dates were confirmed as flat misattributions: the cited Port Commission/Lotus Water material is entirely about the already-tracked Bayfront Park (P22), not either record, so nothing was added to either. Five more records (The Beacon, Mission Bay Commons, the Creek Park's own P1-P3 segment as distinct from P3, and the three UCSF garage/utility-plant records) returned no independently confirmable date and were left as they were, several because realestate.ucsf.edu persistently blocks automated access. Superseded the same day: Clark Construction's own press release states the garage portion started in April 2021, so the April 2021 date rejected above was restored by the next set of research checks. A September 2026 accuracy check noted that the outcomes listed here for P11/P11A, Avalon II, 255 Berry, Mission Creek Park P3 and P26/Block 22 come from Legistar, SEC and Landscape Performance Series pages that were not re-read in that check, and that the May 2020 Regents item and Aug 27, 2024 completion for Block 34 could not be read (realestate.ucsf.edu, stantec.com and commercialsearch.com return 403). item.description: A third set of research claims was verified, under ground rules set after the two earlier sets.
